stories.title: Iran proposes 7-day plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Tehran has proposed a seven-day plan to reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz, seeking a deal with Washington before the U.S. midterm elections, according to CBS News. The move comes amid an ongoing U.S.-Iran conflict that has disrupted the key oil-shipping waterway.

stories.title: DeepMind alumni line up VC cash for non-LLM AI startups
stories.summary: A wave of Google DeepMind alumni are raising nine-figure rounds for startups pursuing alternatives to the transformer architecture behind LLMs: Nando de Freitas is in talks to raise at least $100M for Revolution Labs (diffusion models), David Silver's Ineffable Intelligence has raised roughly $1B, and Jack Parker-Holder's Emulate is seeking $700M. Google and DeepMind have now produced more than 40 'neolab' founders, more than OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta combined per Bloomberg's reporting.

stories.title: TikTok settles Alabama youth-safety suit for at least $100M
stories.summary: TikTok and parent ByteDance agreed to pay Alabama at least $100 million (and up to $300 million if conditions are met) to settle a 2025 lawsuit alleging its algorithm's 'addictive properties' harmed young users - the first state settlement of its kind, reached just before trial. The deal also adds teen safeguards in Alabama: a two-hour daily cap, a midnight-to-6 a.m. ban, a non-personalized feed option, and tighter parental controls.

stories.title: National media predictions lean Buckeyes vs. Illinois
stories.summary: National media previews and predictions for Ohio State's Saturday Big Ten home opener against Illinois (the Illini's first trip to Columbus since 2017) largely favor the Buckeyes, with the running-back flow and defensive-tackle rotation flagged as key questions. One model calls it Ohio State 38, Illinois 20.

stories.title: Azerbaijan GP runs Saturday; Russell on pole
stories.summary: The Azerbaijan Grand Prix runs today, Saturday, instead of Sunday to avoid clashing with Azerbaijan's National Day of Remembrance. Mercedes' George Russell starts a 51-lap race from pole position in Baku, with championship leader Kimi Antonelli exiting in Q2 and Lewis Hamilton sixth.

stories.title: FIA publishes amended Azerbaijan GP grid after late penalties
stories.summary: The FIA has released the amended Azerbaijan Grand Prix starting grid after applying all late penalties from qualifying, reshuffling positions for today's race. George Russell remains at the front on pole.

stories.title: Lewis Hamilton hit with double FIA punishment before Baku
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton faces a double FIA penalty after qualifying ahead of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, adding to a difficult weekend for Ferrari. The penalties will drop the Mercedes-bound driver further down the grid for today's race in Baku.

stories.title: Central Ohio cities debate Flock camera usage
stories.summary: Cities across central Ohio are debating whether to keep or expand Flock automated license-plate-reader cameras, weighing their role in solving crimes against privacy concerns. Local councils have raised questions about data retention, access and civil-liberties safeguards.

stories.title: One killed in South Side shooting in Columbus
stories.summary: One person was found dead in an alley on Columbus' South Side in an apparent fatal shooting, and police are investigating. No arrests have been reported in the case.

stories.title: Dip in Columbus gas prices doesn't erase $4-per-gallon average
stories.summary: A recent dip in Columbus gasoline prices has not pushed the local average back below the $4-per-gallon mark, keeping pump costs elevated for drivers. The modest decline offers only limited relief at the tank.
